name: Knockout Drama: The Round of 32
angle: The 2026 World Cup's brand-new Round of 32 was carnage: Kane's late double rescued England, Belgium roared back from 2-0 down to sink Senegal on the latest goal in World Cup history, Brazil edged Japan and France cruised past Sweden. Curated and de-duplicated from the daily World Cup quiz series.
